ctaHeading: Need a reliable electrician in Melbourne?
aboutText: Pro Connect Electrical has served Melbourne and its suburbs since 2013, with over 12 years of hands-on experience. We specialise in residential electrical installations, commercial fit-outs, and air conditioning for homes and businesses. Our licensed team is certified for all work, providing free quotes with upfront pricing. We are Daikin and Mitsubishi Electric specialists, ensuring quality and reliability for every project.
servicesText: We specialise in electrical installations on new residential developments and air conditioning for homes and businesses across Melbourne. Our certified team handles everything from switchboards to ducted systems.
